'''Tomoe Hanba''' (Japanese: '''半場友恵'''  ''Hanba Tomoe'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hanba was born on June 9, 1972 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Hanba began to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} near the end of {{aniseries|GS}}, with [[Lokoko]] being her first role. Afterwards, she has since provided the voices of many {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]], most notably {{TP|May|May's Squirtle|Wartortle}}, [[Nurse Joy's Chansey]] and two of [[Brandon's legendary giants]] in {{aniseries|RS}}.
